items.title: Beware! Threat Actors Distributing Malicious AI Tools as Chrome Extensions
items.description: A concerning cybersecurity trend has emerged as threat actors exploit the growing popularity of artificial intelligence tools by distributing malicious Chrome extensions masquerading as legitimate platforms. These deceptive extensions target users seeking convenient access to popular services like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Meta Llama, creating a significant security risk for unsuspecting…

items.title: China Imposes One-Hour Reporting Rule for Major Cyber Incidents
items.description: The sweeping new regulations show that China's serious about hardening its own networks after launching widespread attacks on global networks.
